name: 大きな写真と候補一覧の画像選択
prompt: Edit these references into one compact, polished Japanese Lighthouse image-selection component on pure white. Primary authority is the ORIGINAL main crop and its two detail crops. The Japanese mock is secondary only for copy and green styling. Preserve the exact photographic pixels, colors, lighting, orchid stems, white wrapping folds, gray background, crop boundaries, thumbnail proportions and locations; never regenerate, beautify or invent flowers. The large orchid photo is LANDSCAPE, with flower tops clipped at its top just as original; keep this exact framing. Below are exactly TWO small thumbnails at left: selected orchid then unselected coral tulip, with the original white inset and selection outline changed from red to forest green. The photo's bottom-right pill MUST include the original white FOUR-DIRECTION arrow cross: four cardinal arrowheads on crossing shafts, followed by Japanese '移動・サイズ調整'. Restore that icon which the mock omitted. Small Regular Japanese type, Meiryo Regular 14/24 role or 12/16 metadata role, zero tracking, never bold action copy. Pill may use restrained Lighthouse primary green gradient 135deg #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E, white icon and label; keep original photo overlay position and modest compact size. Rounded corners match original. No added headings, frame, phone chrome, shadows, extra controls, or expanded canvas. Output tightly composed standalone raster candidate. Protect photographic media above all; original arrows and exact visible selected state control.
reviewNotes: Original four-direction pan glyph restored and first thumbnail selected in green. Protected main orchid photograph and both thumbnail pixels were resynthesized: changed stems, wrapping creases, flower detail and tulip crop. Action copy also heavier than Regular. Existing LH01-0069 original-only minimal edit failed the exact same thumbnail media; no unchanged retry. Raster candidate only, not owner approved or implemented.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
